head_commit.message:
fix(evidence): store the gate logs as .txt so they are actually tracked

.gitignore line 78 ignores *.log, so the gate and audit logs copied into this evidence folder in the two
previous commits were on disk but not in the repository - those commit messages overstated what landed.
Followed the existing convention from evidence_n24/_n25/_n26 (gate_run_committed.txt, gate_run_final.txt,
gate_run_failed_*.txt): both passing gates (efd6021 and 4a2ffdc, 15/15), the standalone render audit, and
both failed pre-fix runs are now tracked. README records the ignore rule so the next round does not repeat
the mistake.

docs(evidence): file the 15/15 gate log for the round's final head

3642 passed / 25 skipped / 40 deselected in 1430.72s, t82 120/120. Also records why a mid-round standalone

head_commit.message:
docs(round n27): sync report 28.7 with the post-push CI census and file the run payloads

The paragraph written before the push said the branch had exactly 4 workflow runs. Pushing this
round added a third pair, and the new pair repeats the failure signature on the new head 5c93e4de:
Self-check #574 success, CI #244 failure, Install dependencies failing on Python 3.11, Run pytest
failing on Python 3.12, pre-commit py_compile passing. The paragraph now states the read-time census
and the post-push census separately, and says what the divergence means: the local 15-layer gate on the
same commit passes 15/15 with 3642 tests, so the GitHub-side pytest failure is an unresolved
dependency-environment difference rather than a consequence of this round. Payload in
ci_runs_after_push_20261108.json, including the gotcha that the jobs endpoint takes the run id, not
the run number (the number returns 404).

Verified after the 13:09 PDF rebuild that carries the edited paragraph: audit_pdf_render --gate-mode
PASS (0 hard, 0 advisory under the pdfplumber interpreter), triage 0 advisory / 0 genuine absences,
glyph coverage rc=0, doc anchors PASS, stale-strings rc=0, register state rc=0, provenance PASS under
the gate's --allow-unverifiable mode, units/drift/t82 (120/120)/claims/fabrication/breakthrough-label/
hierarchy chain all rc=0, and the doc-facing guards 21 passed.
